product_metadata.title: Uncluttered Designs Stacking Basket Bins (3 Tier + Plate) — Display for Fruit, Potato, Onion & Produce — Crafts, Art Supplies & Housewares Organizer — Bedroom & Bathroom Organization & Storage (White)
features: LOOKS AWESOME WHILE STORING YOUR THINGS — These modern, elegant containers are perfect for looking great while keeping you organized. They work overtime to both organize and display your things beautifully. Cuter than a wire rack or metal stand, less cumbersome than bowls or a box, and less boring than a shelf, these stunning round baskets are a clean, minimalist holder system for decluttering your space. Choose an organizer that complements your decor.

EXTENDS YOUR SPACE – Get clutter-free counters. Because they are freestanding, upright and vertical, our baskets take up very little floor space while giving you tons of storage. We make small spaces bigger to help your home “live large.”

STURDY AND LONG LASTING – Strong, washable and attractive, standing tall like a tower to keep all your items from being crumpled or bruised. Easily store pounds of fruit, vegetables, bananas, garlic, onions, bread, snacks and candy; stacks of kids toys and crafts; piles of pens, pencils, markers and crayons; or oodles of laundry soap and bath bombs.

MULTIPURPOSE AND ADJUSTABLE – Made to be used in every room in the house—kitchen, livingroom, bathroom, home office, dining room, bedside, craft and sewing room, nursery, kids' trinkets and even the garage. Store them in your kitchen cabinet, pantry or closet. On the countertop or on the floor, in a corner or on display. Make them work for you! Choose how many baskets you want to stack and use for your unique uncluttering solution. Portable so you can stay organized wherever you go.

PROFESSIONAL ORGANIZER WITHOUT THE EXPENSE – Get organized! The four layer set includes THREE sturdy baskets and ONE flat plate. Keep your fruit and veggies, kitchen condiments, crafts, pens, markers and crayons, children's toys and baby clothes, bedside items and even bathroom and beauty supplies tidy and organized. What are you waiting for? Get your "unclutter" on with our chic and attractive baskets that keep kitchen or bathroom clutter out of the way.
